 Print Rajinikanth ’s 'Jailer 2' continues its theatrical run in the second week, with the action entertainer maintaining its presence across Tamil, Telugu and Hindi markets. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the sequel has recorded a strong domestic performance since its release. While the film’s opening week brought in substantial collections, its latest numbers point to a slower pace during the weekdays. The coming weekend could play an important role in determining whether the film can regain momentum at the box office. ‘Jailer 2’ box office collection Week 1
 Rajinikanth’s 'Jailer 2' enjoyed a strong opening week, collecting an estimated Rs 317.20 crore net in India. The film opened with Rs 59.70 crore on Day 1, followed by Rs 37.10 crore on Day 2, Rs 47.25 crore on Day 3, and Rs 55.85 crore on Day 4. It went on to earn Rs 42.35 crore on Day 5, Rs 46.80 crore on Day 6 and Rs 28.15 crore on Day 7. The film’s first-week performance reflected strong audience interest across its key language markets, with the Tamil version emerging as its biggest contributor. Its second-week run will now determine how far it can extend its domestic box-office total. ‘Jailer 2’ box office collection Day 9 live update
 According to Sacnilk, 'Jailer 2' has collected an estimated Rs 4.53 crore net in India on Day 9, Friday, October 23. The film is currently running across 5,348 shows. With these live estimates, its total India net collection has reached Rs 338.88 crore, while its domestic gross stands at Rs 396.90 crore. The figures are provisional, and the final Day 9 collection is awaited. Watch Dhols, Crackers and Milk Abhishek: Rajinikanth Fans Celebrate Jailer 2 as Box Office Numbers Roll In The Tamil version leads the film’s Day 9 earnings, contributing Rs 3.03 crore net from 2,474 shows. The Telugu version has collected Rs 1.05 crore from 943 shows, while the Hindi version has earned Rs 0.45 crore from 1,931 shows. These are live estimates and may change as the day progresses. ‘Jailer 2’ Day-Wise Box Office Collection
 Week 1: Rs 317.20 crore Day 8: Rs 17.15 crore Day 9 [LIVE]: Rs 4.53 crore Total India net: Rs 338.88 crore Total India gross: Rs 396.90 crore About Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’
 The sequel brings Rajinikanth back as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, with Nelson Dilipkumar returning as director and Anirudh Ravichander composing the music. The film also features Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar, Ramya Krishnan, Mithun Chakraborty, S. J. Suryah, Namo Narayanan, and Yogi Babu in key roles. DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. This data is provided for informational and entertainment purposes only.
